searchText: You can use geth for example <https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/interface/managing-your-accounts> Or a Python library: <https://pypi.org/project/hdwallet/> Or if you feel particularly unixy: https://kobl.one/blog/create-full-ethereum-keypair-and-address/ Hello, I'm new at this. I have a question. Whenever a wallet is created on the Ethereum network, does it have a private key? There's always a private key to every public key Weather someone has no knowledge and deleted that is a different measure Also I'm not sure if the fee burning does OK. Ammm and when the wallet is created in Eth Network automatically the same address is created on the bsc network? I send funds from my binance chain wallet to erc-20 address on a platform. I see my funds in that address but within the binance network 😦 When I registered on the platform they only gave me a public address without a private key or anything to import 😦 Are you talking about using an exchange? Like binance? You don't own your coins when they're on an exchange, they hold the keys. Not your keys, not your coins On exchanges they hold the private key The platform is Rollercoin
